svg.aria-label: Diagram: you message shell3 on Telegram; every tool call passes your hook gate before the agent acts through bash and edit on your shell; the agent delegates to project managers, subagents and cron jobs; every background completion arrives as mail: failures and direct results post to the chat; everything else wakes the agent quietly, which messages you only when it matters.
svg.text: ONE GO BINARY · ONE FOLDER OF PLAIN FILES
thread; the web dash shows jobs & runs
the whole Unix toolbox, on your box
a brief + a manager, its shell in
EVERY BACKGROUND RESULT COMES BACK THROUGH ONE FUNNEL
— mails the agent; its reply arrives as ✉️
— how the agent stays silent on routine mail
so a periodic checklist only speaks up when something needs attention
